title: Superlatives
objectives: Use superlatives accurately in A2 contexts.
Understand form, meaning, and typical usage.
Produce short spoken and written examples.
canDo: I can use superlatives to say something is #1 in a group.

warmUp.title: Activate prior knowledge
warmUp.prompt: Before this lesson, recall what you know about superlatives. How is it similar or different from Portuguese?
reflectionQuestions: When do native speakers use superlatives?
Can you think of one example?

explanation:
The + -est (the oldest) or the most + adj (the most interesting).

Irregular: the best, the worst

grammar.title: Superlatives
grammar.rule: The + -est (the oldest) or the most + adj (the most interesting).

examples.sentence: This is the best pizza in town.

vocabulary.example: This is the best pizza in town.

sentences: This is the best pizza in town.

reading.title: Superlatives in Context
reading.text: It is the tallest building in the city. She is the most experienced person on the team. That was the worst meal we have had.

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph (5–7 sentences) using superlatives. Use at least 3 words from the vocabulary list.
rubricHints: Use the target structure at least twice.
writing.modelAnswer: This is the best pizza in town. The worst film ever. The most popular song. Famous in the world.

tutorHints: Correct gently and ask the learner to reformulate.
Use English for meta-language when possible at A2.
